answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared kernel contract before it can earn: the stake is the walnut shell, hard to crack open cheaply, so spawning thousands of fake identities means locking thousands of stakes. A reputation kernel then tracks each identity across a canyon of time, so a fresh fake starts with zero trust and must pay real compute and delay before its votes count. Attackers pay per identity; honest agents pay once.
